title: 36 Hours in Galway, Ireland
abstract: Nestled along the country’s western coast, Galway is often called Ireland’s most Irish city. And while you can still get a Guinness served with Gaelic, a global flavor is emerging.

title: 36 Hours in Managua, Nicaragua
abstract: This city may lack conventional addresses, but determined visitors can find everything from boiled-cheese snacks to a swimmable volcanic lake in Nicaragua’s capital.

title: 36 Hours in Baltimore
abstract: From art to crabs, dive bars to “The Wire,” Natty Boh to the home of Poe, this is a textured town with multiple identities.

title: 36 Hours in Dubrovnik, Croatia
abstract: With its medieval Old Town and bird’s-eye views of the Adriatic, Dubrovnik is no longer anyone’s best-kept secret.
